media:group.media:title: Nora En Pure - Space (Paradoks Remix)
media:group.media:description:
Stream / Download: https://nep.lnk.to/SpaceParadoksRemixSC Paradoks takes Nora En Pure’s “Space” into a new dimension with a remix built for moments when emotion and energy collide. Keeping the emotional core of the original vocals intact, Paradoks transforms the track into a euphoric, anthemic progressive journey, powered by a driving kick and bass combination, emotional pads, and a soaring synth lead with a distinctive triplet rhythm.
Already tested across Hï Ibiza and other major venues, the remix is designed to hit wherever the energy peaks—from daytime festival stages to late-night clubs and those hands-in-the-air moments when a set reaches its emotional high point. The production balances melodic depth with serious dancefloor momentum, giving Space a fresh identity without losing the feeling at its heart.
Based in Ebmatingen, Paradoks has built a strong reputation within the progressive and melodic scene, with previous releases receiving support from an impressive roster including ARTBAT, David Guetta, Armin van Buuren, Tiësto, Miss Monique, Korolova, Joris Voorn, Vintage Culture, Lost Frequencies, Kevin de Vries, Massano, Morten, Nora En Pure, Agents Of Time, Innellea, Pete Tong, Above & Beyond, and Lane 8. With the Space remix, Paradoks adds another powerful chapter to that trajectory—an expansive, high-energy rework built to make an impact wherever it lands.

entry.title: Nora En Pure feat. Orem - Burning Up

media:group.media:title: Nora En Pure feat. Orem - Burning Up
media:group.media:description:
Stream / Download: https://nep.lnk.to/BurningUp
Returning to her home imprint with a soul-stirring original, Nora En Pure teams up with Orem for ‘Burning Up’ on Enormous Tunes.
Following her last original release, ‘Don’t Wake Up’ with Richard Walters, and her official remix for powerhouse artists HAYLA and Nelly Furtado on ‘Faded’, ‘Burning Up’ sees Nora En Pure reconnect with the emotive, organic qualities that have become synonymous with her sound for over a decade.
A delicate balance of classical influence and melodic house sensibilities, the track unfolds with Orem’s touching vocal performance, delicate instrumentals and an effortless groove. Rich in atmosphere and emotion, ‘Burning Up’ is another outstanding addition to her catalogue on Enormous Tunes.
